scientific_integrity: The analytic infinite-dimensional proof uses an explicit polar decomposition, a fully detailed square-zero-corner interpolation inequality, Schatten trace duality and finite-rank approximation. Finite checker assertions are supplementary, not proofs of infinite statements. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns square-zero targets in complex Schatten classes for 1<=p<infinity. It makes no assertion for general nonnilpotent targets, exponents below one, mixed factor exponents or classification of all optimizers. Publication-priority assessment is provisional.
title: Optimal Schatten commutator cost for square-zero operators
